SRC-282:R001.text: On a fixture whose validator capture takes 60 s, saipen transition BUILD must not refuse a concurrent short mutation arriving 1 s later: it waits within the declared budget and succeeds; an unbounded holder is still refused in bounded time.

SRC-282:R002.text: A WRITER_BUSY refusal names the holder PID and command when the holder is a SAIPEN process, and otherwise states plainly that the holder is unknown.

SRC-282:R003.text: No protocol operation holds the project writer lock across an external process for more than a declared small bound.

SRC-282:R004.text: saipen status remains lock-free: it answers while another writer holds the lock and never acquires it.

SRC-282:R005.text: A held project writer lock is still released by process death; no PID-file lease may outlive its owner or gate acquisition.

SRC-282:R006.text: The pre-BUILD debt baseline (debt.ensure_debt_baseline) and DONE-Work re-verification (debt.reverify_work) must not hold the project writer lock across their validator capture or verification-command subprocesses: they capture outside, then re-check the recorded board_sha256, state_sha256, log_fingerprint and source identity under the lock before journaling.

SRC-282:R007.text: WriterLock.acquire's docstring must describe the real bounded acquisition, and the saipen/CORE.md writer-lock sentence must state the bounded wait, its environment override and the WRITER_BUSY refusal, so contract and engine agree.

SRC-282:R008.text: Do not delete .saipen/locks/core.lock to cure a held lock: it is a permanent lock carrier, not a stale-lock marker, and its existence is normal.
